questions.a: MOQ runs 12-120 pcs per style. The figure for each style is confirmed with your quotation — nothing is published before it is checked.

questions.q: Can I order below a style's MOQ?
questions.a: Quantities below a style's MOQ can be quoted — flag it at submission and it will be confirmed with your quotation.
Priced by tier. Where a style's tiered pricing is confirmed, the reference range appears on its page; otherwise the full tier table is quoted per order with your RFQ.

questions.q: Can I order a sample before bulk?
questions.a: Yes. Samples are priced at the wholesale reference tier, quoted per order. See the samples page for shipping, returns and dispatch rules.

questions.q: Is the sample fee credited to my first order?
questions.a: Sample fees can be credited in full to your first bulk order — the threshold is stated in your sample quotation.

questions.q: Can I mix styles in one sample box?
questions.a: Mixed styles within one sample box are allowed — the limit per request is confirmed with your quote.

questions.q: What is the production and shipping lead time?
questions.a: Lead time is quoted per order. It depends on the styles, quantities and inspection level in your order.

questions.q: Which delivery terms do you support?
questions.a: EXW, FOB and DDP. EXW — you collect from our warehouse. FOB — we deliver to the vessel at the named Chinese port. DDP — we handle transport and import duty to your door.
Carrier options and transit times are quoted per order and destination.

questions.q: Do you support private label and OEM?
questions.a: Yes — your branding, our workshop network, quoted per order. State the requirement in the RFQ notes.
Engraving, plating tone and packaging are commonly quoted customizations. Ask with your RFQ and the answer is in writing.

questions.q: What payment methods and terms do you accept?
questions.a: Payment methods and terms are stated with your quotation.

questions.q: What happens if goods arrive defective?
questions.a: Defects are replaced or credited after photo review — the claim window is written into your order confirmation.

Test reports are issued per batch and provided with your quotation for the matching product. There is no site-wide blanket pass claim — each report is linked to the alloy, plating and batch you are buying.

questions.q: What is the nickel release limit?
questions.a: 0.5 µg/cm²/week for coated articles after EN 12472 wear simulation; 0.2 µg/cm²/week for pierced articles such as ear posts. See the nickel release explainer for how the testing works.

questions.q: How do I verify a test report?
questions.a: Cross-check the report number with the issuing laboratory. A report without all four attributes — standard, laboratory, report number, date — is not evidence.
